title: Edgar Evins Marina

services.name: Slip Rentals
services.desc: With over 338 slips ranging from 10' x 20' to 23' x 100', we can accommodate any vessel. Covered and uncovered slips are available. Choose between a 3,000 lbs or 6,000 lbs Hydrohoist boat lift, and we'll have it installed in no time. Jet Ski lifts are also available. For our slip tenants, we offer a washroom with a washer/dryer combo and a full restroom complete with a walk-in shower. At Edgar Evins, tenant-first service ensures smooth sailing every time.
